stories.headline: The Roosters come from behind to win the NRL grand final
stories.summary: The Sydney Roosters beat the Newcastle Knights 19–18 in the NRL grand final at Accor Stadium on 4 October. They had trailed by six points at half-time, and the win gave them the Provan-Summons Trophy for the first time since 2019. The Roosters captain, James Tedesco, took the Clive Churchill Medal as player of the match.

stories.headline: Brazil's presidential election goes to a run-off
stories.summary: Brazilians voted on 4 October to elect a president, a vice president and the members of the National Congress. In the first round Senator Flávio Bolsonaro took 47% of the vote and the incumbent president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, took 45%. The two will meet again in a run-off on 25 October 2026.

stories.headline: Latvia's United List wins the most seats in the Saeima
stories.summary: Latvians voted on 3 October 2026 to elect the Saeima, their 100-member parliament. Preliminary results indicate that the centrist United List won the most seats. The party is led by the incumbent prime minister, Andris Kulbergs.

stories.headline: An Oklahoma crater turns out to be far younger than thought
stories.summary: A meteor impact structure lies buried beneath the town of Ames in Oklahoma. It had been grouped with a cluster of impacts dated to roughly 467.5 million years ago, but zircon crystals from granite altered by the strike now date it to about 370 million years ago. That makes the crater nearly 100 million years younger than previously believed.
